quick_start.title: Bat dau nhanh
quick_start.summary: Ket noi, dong bo, bo sung chi phi va kiem tra shadow truoc khi thao tac that.
quick_start.purpose: Tao khong gian GMV MAX co the chan doan, phe duyet va truy vet.
quick_start.when: Lan dau su dung, doi cua hang hoac uy quyen lai TikTok.
quick_start.data: Ket noi hop le, lien ket cua hang, chien dich, san pham, noi dung va it nhat mot ngay bao cao day du.
quick_start.logic: He thong kiem tra bon lop: ket noi, du lieu, loi nhuan va xac minh lich su. Lop thieu khong duoc hien la co the thuc thi.

steps.1: Ket noi TikTok va kiem tra quyen tai khoan, cua hang, chien dich.
steps.2: Dong bo du lieu, sau do dong bo san pham va noi dung.
steps.3: Bo sung gia, chi phi va quy tac hoan tien cho san pham.
steps.4: Xem chan doan va de xuat shadow truoc khi mo quyen phe duyet.

quick_start.result: He thong hien dung doi tuong, nguong loi nhuan, van de va loi vao xu ly.
quick_start.risk: Khong duyet ngan sach hoac ROI khi chi phi thieu hay du lieu cu.

data_sync.title: Dong bo du lieu
data_sync.summary: Hieu dong bo toan bo, dong bo danh muc va do moi du lieu.
data_sync.purpose: Cap nhat chien dich, bao cao, san pham, noi dung va uy quyen tu nen tang.
data_sync.when: Truoc khi review hang ngay, sau khi sua tren nen tang, hoac khi du lieu cu hay bi gian doan.
data_sync.data: Ket noi va quyen doc hop le. Ngay day du tinh theo mui gio cua hang.
data_sync.logic: Dong bo toan bo xu ly cua hang, chien dich, bao cao, realtime va SOP. Dong bo danh muc xu ly san pham, noi dung, uy quyen va SOP.

steps.1: Xac nhan cua hang va ngay thong ke.
steps.2: Bat dau dong bo va cho tien do chan thao tac hoan tat.
steps.3: Neu loi, xem dung giai doan va khong bam lai dong thoi.
steps.4: Kiem tra ngay phan phoi moi nhat va nguon du lieu.

data_sync.result: SOP, cap noi dung va chan doan loi nhuan duoc tinh lai.
data_sync.risk: Thoi gian dong bo khong phai ngay phan phoi; ngay thieu khong phai gia tri 0.

overview.title: Tong quan kinh doanh
overview.summary: Xem rui ro, loi nhuan va hanh dong cho xu ly truoc chi tiet.
overview.purpose: Tong hop chi phi, GMV, don, ROI, bao ve loi nhuan va phe duyet.
overview.when: Review hang ngay, kiem tra bat thuong va bao cao nhanh.
overview.data: Bao cao chien dich, mo hinh chi phi, chien luoc va trang thai dong bo.
overview.logic: Chi so tong hop theo cua hang, loai va ngay day du da chon. Ket luan loi nhuan can du do phu chi phi.

steps.1: Chon cua hang, loai va khoang ngay.
steps.2: Kiem tra bao ve loi nhuan, do moi va canh bao.
steps.3: Mo van de uu tien cao nhat.
steps.4: Dong bo lai sau xu ly va kiem tra trang thai.

overview.result: Biet doi tuong nao can xu ly truoc va ly do.
overview.risk: Du lieu tong hop khong thay the ngan sach san pham va chi phi trong ngay.

sop.title: SOP 30 ngay
sop.summary: San pham moi, san pham cu va LIVE co lo trinh rieng.
sop.purpose: Chuyen van hanh thanh giai doan, van de, tac vu ngay, mot de xuat va khoa theo doi.
sop.when: Ra mat san pham, phuc hoi san pham cu, ho tro LIVE va tang co kiem soat.
sop.data: Tuoi san pham, ngay phan phoi, don, loi nhuan, noi dung, LIVE va du lieu bo sung.
sop.logic: Ngay chi xac dinh giai doan som nhat; bang chung quyet dinh chuyen giai doan. San pham cu dung hoac du lieu cu vao chan doan phuc hoi.

steps.1: Xac nhan san pham, chien dich, cua hang va lo trinh.
steps.2: Xu ly van de bat buoc dau tien.
steps.3: Chi doi mot bien va theo doi ba ngay phan phoi.
steps.4: Chi chuyen khi co lai, du du lieu va du noi dung.

sop.result: Moi doi tuong co giai doan, chan tro, loi xu ly va dieu kien ro rang.
sop.risk: Ghi ly do khi doi lo trinh. Khong chay san pham cu theo cold start.

campaigns.title: Chien dich
campaigns.summary: Xem ngan sach, ROI muc tieu, toc do, hoc va bao ve.
campaigns.purpose: Xac dinh suc khoe chien dich va mo bang chung cung hanh dong.
campaigns.when: Chi phi bat thuong, ROI bien dong, chien dich tat hoac can tang co kiem soat.
campaigns.data: Cai dat chien dich, bao cao, chi phi trong ngay, chien luoc va nguong loi nhuan.
campaigns.logic: Toc do so sanh thoi diem hien tai voi ngay lich su hop le. Khong dung tong chien dich thay du lieu san pham bi thieu.

steps.2: Kiem tra trang thai, ngan sach, ROI va ngay du lieu.
steps.3: Xem gia tri hien tai va de xuat.
steps.4: Dung trang phe duyet cho moi thao tac ghi.

campaigns.result: Van de gan voi dung chien dich va bien can sua.
campaigns.risk: Giai doan phuc hoi khong duoc bat Auto Budget, Max Delivery hay tang ngan sach ngay.

growth.title: Tang truong va hoc
growth.summary: Nhan dien san pham co the tang, dang thu va suy giam.
growth.purpose: Danh gia vong doi, phan bo, ket qua hanh dong va co hoi tang truong.
growth.when: Sau khi loi nhuan on dinh, cham tran hoac can so sanh dong gop.
growth.data: Chi phi, GMV, don, ROI, loi nhuan, so noi dung va ket qua hanh dong.
growth.logic: Bao ve loi nhuan va Winner da xac minh truoc, sau do phan bo thu nghiem va tang truong.

steps.1: Sap xep theo loi nhuan hoac tiem nang.
steps.2: Mo san pham va xem du lieu gan voi lich su.
steps.3: Xac nhan chi phi va nguon noi dung.
steps.4: Gui de xuat hop le sang phe duyet.

growth.result: Hanh dong tang truong co san pham, chu ky va tac dong loi nhuan.
growth.risk: Du bao khong phai cam ket cua nen tang va can xac minh bang ngay phan phoi.

rules.title: Cai dat chien luoc
rules.summary: Dat ranh gioi uu tien loi nhuan, can bang hoac tang GMV.
rules.purpose: Dinh nghia nguong ROI, ngan sach test, ty le kham pha va quyen ghi.
rules.when: Khoi tao, doi muc tieu hoac bat ban nhap SOP tu dong.
rules.data: Nguong loi nhuan, CPA, quy mo noi dung va muc chap nhan rui ro.
rules.logic: Chien luoc chi doi ranh gioi de xuat. Ghi that van can quyen, phe duyet, khoa mot bien va xac minh nen tang.

steps.1: Chon preset phu hop muc tieu.
steps.2: Kiem tra ROI, CPA va ngan sach test.
steps.3: Mo tung quyen ngan sach, ROI, trang thai hoac noi dung.
steps.4: Chay shadow truoc ban nhap tu dong.

rules.result: Quyet dinh dung gia tri chien luoc hien tai co the truy vet.
rules.risk: Khong doi nhieu nguong cung luc vi se mat kha nang quy ket.

creatives.title: Khong gian noi dung
creatives.summary: Quan ly Winner, co the tiep tuc, cho xac minh va ung vien loai.
creatives.purpose: Xem video va du lieu, sau do tao hanh dong heat, loai hoac xoay vong de phe duyet.
creatives.when: Thieu noi dung, ROI giam, can tang quy mo hoac loai chi phi lang phi.
creatives.data: Danh tinh video, hien thi, nhap, CTR, don, GMV, chi phi, ROI, do sau va uy quyen.
creatives.logic: S la Winner co lai; A co chuyen doi ben vung; B co hien thi cho xac minh; C co nhap va chuyen doi thap. Winner lich su co lai duoc bao ve.

steps.1: Loc theo cap va sap xep theo loi nhuan, ROI hoac do moi.
steps.2: Mo preview va kiem tra danh tinh cung bang chung.
steps.3: Heat can ngan sach, bat dau, ket thuc; truoc khi loai can kiem tra bao ve Winner.
steps.4: Gui phe duyet va theo doi loi nhuan that.

creatives.result: Moi thao tac co doi tuong, lich, ngan sach, ly do va nhat ky.
creatives.risk: Khong heat hay loai khi thieu du lieu. Trang tro giup khong tao ban nhap hay ghi nen tang.

profit.title: Bao ve loi nhuan
profit.summary: Tinh Break-even ROI va nguong hieu luc tu chi phi day du.
profit.purpose: Khong de GMV hay ROI che mat mua hang, van chuyen, hoa hong va hoan tra.
profit.when: Khoi tao san pham, doi chi phi, doi tien te hoac canh bao lo.
profit.data: Gia, mua hang, dau cuoi, kho, hoa hong, ty le tra va ton that tra hang.
profit.logic: Break-even ROI bang doanh thu chia chi phi quang cao cho phep. Nguong hieu luc cong bien an toan hien tai.

steps.1: Loc san pham va kiem tra tien te.
steps.2: Bo sung chi phi san pham hoac bien the.
steps.3: Luu va xem do phu cung nguong.
steps.4: Tinh lai SOP va de xuat.

profit.result: Ngan sach, ROI va noi dung duoc bao ve boi loi nhuan that.
profit.risk: Sai tien te, hoan tien hoac chi phi mac dinh se doi ket qua.

actions.title: Hanh dong phe duyet
actions.summary: Kiem tra gia tri, bang chung va rui ro truoc khi ghi that.
actions.purpose: Duyet ngan sach, ROI, trang thai va noi dung, co nhat ky va hoan tac.
actions.when: Sau khi SOP hoac bo toi uu tao de xuat cho duyet.
actions.data: Gia tri truoc sau, ngay bang chung, nguong loi nhuan, don, quyen va khoa theo doi.
actions.logic: Chi phe duyet moi ghi that. Nen tang chap nhan va xac minh trang thai la hai buoc. Trang thai khong ro can kiem tra truoc thu lai.

steps.1: Loc chien dich va trang thai cho duyet.
steps.2: Kiem tra bien, muc doi, nguong va ngay.
steps.3: Duyet hoac tu choi mot hanh dong.
steps.4: Xem request ID, xac minh va ket qua theo doi.

actions.result: Moi thay doi co phe duyet, request, ket qua va kha nang hoan tac.
actions.risk: Khong thu lai lenh khong ro trang thai vi co the ghi hai lan.

audit.title: Ket noi va nhat ky
audit.summary: Theo doi kha nang, request, loi va trang thai thuc thi that.
audit.purpose: Xac nhan quyen doc ghi va truy vet moi thao tac.
audit.when: Khi thuc thi loi, doi quyen, lech trang thai hoac can review.
audit.data: Kha nang ket noi, hanh dong, request ID, loi va thoi gian.
audit.logic: Nhat ky phan biet bat dau, chap nhan, da xac minh, that bai va khong ro.

steps.1: Loc theo chien dich, trang thai hoac hanh dong.
steps.2: Xem request ID va chi tiet loi.
steps.3: Kiem tra tren nen tang truoc neu trang thai khong ro.
steps.4: Chi thu lai khi chua ghi, hoac hoan tac khi du dieu kien.

audit.result: Biet he thong da lam gi, nen tang tra gi va trang thai cuoi.
audit.risk: Accepted chua xac minh khong co nghia cai dat da co hieu luc.

metrics.title: Chi so va cong thuc
metrics.summary: Hieu ROI, Net ROI, Live Score va do phu suc khoe san pham cu.
metrics.purpose: Dung cung mot dinh nghia va khong coi gia tri thieu la 0.
metrics.when: Kiem tra chan doan, so bao cao hoac giai thich giai doan bi chan.
metrics.data: Chi phi, GMV, hoan tien, don, nhap, hien thi, pheu LIVE va moc lich su.
metrics.logic: ROI=GMV/chi phi; Net GMV=GMV-hoan tien; Net ROI=Net GMV/chi phi. Live Score gom nhap 30%, dat 40%, tra 20%, o lai 10%.

steps.1: Xac nhan ngay, mui gio va tien te.
steps.2: Tach ngay thieu, ngay chi phi 0 va ngay phan phoi day du.
steps.3: Xem nguon va thoi gian cap nhat.
steps.4: So voi chien luoc hien tai, khong dung mot gia tri co dinh chung.

metrics.result: Chi so co the tinh lai va truy nguon.
metrics.risk: Ngay khong chi phi khong phai ngay co lai. Do phu san pham cu duoi 80% chi cho chan doan.

execution.title: Thuc thi that va hoan tac
execution.summary: Hieu phe duyet, chap nhan, xac minh, theo doi va hoan tac.
execution.purpose: Bao dam de xuat thanh thao tac that co kiem soat, khong ghi trung hay nhieu bien.
execution.when: Truoc phe duyet, sau loi, sau suy giam hoac truoc khoi phuc.
execution.data: Phe duyet, request ID, phan hoi nen tang, gia tri truoc sau va ba ngay phan phoi.
execution.logic: Chi mot bien duoc thuc thi. Bien khac khoa ba ngay phan phoi, sau do he thong giu hoac de xuat hoan tac theo loi nhuan.

steps.1: Xac nhan ket noi ho tro thao tac ghi.
steps.2: Duyet mot hanh dong va ghi request.
steps.3: Dong bo va xac minh trang thai nen tang.
steps.4: Sau theo doi, giu hoac duyet hoan tac.

execution.result: Hanh dong that tao vong truy vet tu de xuat den ket qua.
execution.risk: Thao tac Seller Center can gia tri, ngay va bang chung de hoan thanh.

issues.title: Kho kien thuc van de
issues.summary: Bao phu chan tro SOP, bat thuong, dong bo loi va ghi loi.
issues.purpose: Giai thich ly do, gia tri, loi xu ly va dieu kien hoan thanh.
issues.when: Khi co the van de SOP hoac chua ro buoc tiep theo.
issues.data: Ma van de, bang chung, muc tieu, nguon va trang thai hanh dong.
issues.logic: Van de xep theo bat buoc, nen toi uu, dang theo doi va da giai quyet. Moi ma co mot hop dong xu ly on dinh.

steps.1: Mo van de tu danh sach hien tai hoac tim kiem.
steps.2: Doc ly do, gia tri va dieu kien.
steps.3: Theo buoc trong he thong hoac Seller Center.
steps.4: Dong bo bang chung moi de he thong xac minh.

issues.result: Moi van de co cach xu ly cu the thay vi goi y chung.
issues.risk: Van de cho du lieu khong the danh dau thu cong va can bang chung that.
